It is said that there was an old Kanakanavu person.

S.TRANSL: 這個話,或許你們未曾聽過.
As for this story, perhaps you haven't heard about it.

Now I want to chat about...say about that.

FORM.notes: source note: 此處以及下面用kan的次數非常多，均表示聽來的故事。此為卡那卡那富語的語言表達所需，翻譯時不一一表示。 | source note: ni-musa完整的形式為ni-m-okusa (PFV-AF-go)。 | source note: rʉmʉra意為「叢林」或「雜草叢生的地方」。 | source note: 此IU與IU 14同，不翻譯兩次。

S.FORM: 'una kan mamarang miana ʉʉ nimusa kan rʉmʉra nimusa kan rʉmʉra.

S.TRANSL: 那一個人(另外一個人)就那樣.

S.PHON: ʔɨɨ nakai miaa makaʔu[r|ɾ]u ia ʔuna kan ʔɨɨ sua ʔutinni ia ʔɨɨ tupu[r|ɾ]uiin kan nia takipɨnɨn kan kee sua ʔutinni na ɨnɨʔɨnai
S.FORM: 'ʉʉ nakai miaa maka'uru ia 'una kan 'ʉʉ sua 'utinni ia 'ʉʉ tupuruiin kan nia takipʉnʉn kan kee sua 'utinni na ʉnʉ'ʉnai.

FORM.notes: source note: tuu為布農語，相當於卡那卡那富語的ia。 | source note: 比較：mo-siparʉ為經由涉水抵達對岸，而mo-sipara則純指到對岸，不限定方法。 | source note: tapeca原來的形式為ta-paica，ta-表示「到」，paica則由maica而來，表示「通過」。

S.FORM: 'ʉʉ noo makasiin kan cau tuu teku mosiparʉ 'akia tapeca misa kani ia.
S.PHON: ʔɨɨ noo makasiin kan ʦau tuu teku mosipa[r|ɾ]ɨ ʔakia tapeʦa misa kani ia

S.TRANSL: 我想要涉水到對岸,(但說)沒有通道.
I wanted to go to the opposite bank through water, (but he) said there was no passage.

FORM.notes: source note: 「拉」的主焦形式為m-arisʉ'ʉrʉ。

S.FORM: arisʉ'ʉrʉnkan kee 'utini mari marikusa sipara.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]isɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]ɨnkan kee ʔutini ma[r|ɾ]i ma[r|ɾ]ikusa sipa[r|ɾ]a
S.FORM: arisʉ'ʉrʉnkan kee 'utini mari marikusa sipara.

S.TRANSL: 他拉著他的生殖器到對岸.

FORM.notes: source note: tʉtan表示「水道」（與mo-tʉ-tʉnaa相關），類似cungkucu，但為只允許一個人可以過的通道，亦可指懸崖。 | source note: sian表示「我這裡」，距離說話者比nesi「這裡」更接近。

S.FORM: mo motʉtʉnaa sian kisʉʉn kan kee sua cau.

FORM.notes: source note: 老師不確定taniuru'e的意思。 | source note: 老師不確定tumani'ura的意思，但提出另一個字t<um>a-tinara'U(T<AF>A-act.up)「搗蛋」，並覺得這一句話應該是在講這個意思。

S.FORM: makasuacu araneecu nia taniuru'ecu kan cau tumani'ura e rʉmʉra.

S.TRANSL: ＂啊,走吧,我們逃離,有人正要傷害我們.＂
"Ah, let's go, let's escape, there is someone wanting to damage us."

They had no choice but to lose their head there, becuase (all) others already escaped.

S.TRANSL: 像我一樣呆呆的,沒有他所知道的.
Like me, who was silly and didn't have something I knew.

(He) wanted to escape, (but) went through the places rich in yellow rattan.

He dragged his genital (through) the places of yellow rattan, feeling toilsome in that way.

He said, "I wanted to ask someone to work at the cost of my genital."

S.FORM: nakai tia naannakʉ kan kavangvang 'aaka kan saronee.

S.TRANSL: 但是都要是女性,男人不行.
But all should be women, man are not OK.
